newsitem.title: CANADA: Pattison raises BC Sugar stake.
newsitem.headline: Pattison raises BC Sugar stake.

text.p: Vancouver financier Jim Pattison said Thursday his Great Pacific Industries Inc purchased another 980,000 Class A shares of BC Sugar Refinery Ltd, raising its stake to 24.8 percent.
Pattison said the shares were bought for investment purposes.
Analysts have speculated that Pattison or Belkin might seek to take control of BC Sugar.
BC Sugar Class A shares rose 0.20 to 13.60 on volume of nearly one million shares on the Toronto exchange, making the stock one of the day's most actively traded.
Pattison previously held about 20 percent of BC Sugar.

Shareholders of the company including Pattison and BC Sugar director Stuart Belkin, whose holding company owns 19 percent of the sugar refiner, last week passed a motion overturning the company's poison pill. The move was seen by investors as potentially opening the company up to a takeover effort.

Pattison said Thursday he might raise or lower his stake in BC Sugar based on "a number of factors, including general market and economic conditions and other investment and business opportunities available to (his) company."
